scripts.build:frontend: ([ -d frontend/node_modules ] || npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund) && npm --prefix frontend run build && rm -rf frontend/node_modules
scripts.build: ([ -d backend/node_modules ] || npm --prefix backend install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund) && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: ([ -f frontend/build/index.html ] || npm run build) && node backend/index.js
